sanjay: quick smoke on Orpheus-v1 q4 found a locale issue: mixed Han + Arabic-Indic digits get their order flipped and punctuation attaches to wrong side. BLEU fell 3.9 -> 1.8. anyone seen digit mirroring with quant builds?
liyue: heard of bidi quirks when detok optimizations run on packed memory. can you paste a minimal repro and token dump?
sanjay: repro src: "2026年有三家。" expected ar digits: U+0662 U+0660 U+0662 U+0666. orpheus-q4 output shows digits permuted and comma shifted. running: `./eng-ml/evals/run_locale_eval --model orpheus-v1 --quant q4 --pairs zh-ar --subset mixed-numerals`
maria: if tokens are correct but string wrong, detok likely doing an in-place reverse. try toggling the detok numeric-reorder pass off. I'll add a unit with Han+Arabic-Indic sample.
kai: quick note: q4 packer changes byte lane order; a C-extension that assumes iteration order can break. I'll add a CI smoke gate for mixed-orientation on quant builds.
ml-ci-bot: staging run 1757773333 queued; locale mixed-numerals failing (2/4). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/1757773333/logs
maria: taking detok patch; will revert numeric-reorder and push unit test. report back when staging passes.
sanjay: thanks, team :thumbsup:
